tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rngog lo chen po blo ldan shes rab kyi spring yig bdud rtsi'i theg le bzhugs so/ /

dad pa'i gzhi brtan 'dun pa'i rtsa ba bzang po can/ / sems dpa'i rang gzhan bsam pa'i sdong pos rnam mdzes shing/ / sgrub pa'i me tog rab rgyas bsdu ba'i grib bsil can/ / gzhan don 'bras bu mngar ldan 'phags pa'i ljon tshogs khyed/ / rang bzhin mkhar gnas tshul min yid byed klus sprul pa// gti mug sprin tshogs chags pa'i glog gi phreng ba can/ / zhe sdang 'brug sgra chem chem sgrog pa las 'thon pa| | nyes spyod gnam lcags 'bar bas phog par ma gyur cig / skye ba'i rjes 'ongs na dang rga ba'i mche rnon can/ / mi rtag lus can 'chi bdag srin po ltar 'ongs nas/ / ngan 'gro ba gnas sdug bsngal mun chen mtha' yas par/ / skye bo'i tshogs 'di dbang med khrid cing nges par bsam/ / sdug bsngal mang ldan 'di 'dra'i g.yang sa dran byas nas/ / bag yod stobs skyod lus dang srog la mi 'phangs ltar/ / nyon mongs dgra tshogs gzhom la lhod pa med yid kyis/ / brtson pa'i go bgos bzod pa'i bsran ni legs gzugs bya/ / 'chi bdag dpung 'joms sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem byed pa/ / bde ba'i 'byung gnas rin chen byang chub sems bskyed de/ /bdag don lhur byed srid dang zhi ba'i skye bo la/ / dman par bltas nas snying rje'i yul du gnyis ka bzhag / thar pa'i khang bzangs pha rol phyin drug them skas can/ / bag chags spangs pa'i rwa ba brtan pos yongs skor ba/ / ye shes rtsig pa gzhan don rnga sgras mdzes pa der/ / bdag nyid 'dzegs nas gzhan yang drang ba'i thabs la 'bad/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa sdug bsngal nad kun zhi byed pa'i/ / bdud rtsi mchog 'di rnyed nas don med mi 'gyur phyir/ / thub mchog gis bcas bslab gzhi rnams las mi 'da' bar/ / brtul zhugs legs bsrung bshes gnyen bzang la rab bsten bya/ / chos spyod la brtson yid bzhin gzhan don lhur len pa/ / 'gro ba dad gyur dam pa'i spyod pa rjes su brten/ /bshes gnyen sprin las legs byung mang du thos pa yi/

/ char rgyun bsil bas nyon mongs gdung ba zhi byed kyis/ / bde gshegs snying po'i sa bon rab tu brlan byas nas/ / sangs rgyas yon tan phun tshogs lo tog rab rgyas bya/ / chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa'i tshul la 'jug pa'i sgo/ / yang dag rigs tshogs klu sgrub zhal nas gsungs pa de/ / rigs pa'i dbang phyug rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung mdzes las/ / gsal bar rtogs nas lugs ngan gzhan kun rtsa bzhin dor/ / paṇ+ḍi ta zhes rab grags 'dir 'ongs phal cher yang*/ / gzhung lugs mi mkhas rang gi ngan rtog gis khrid cing*/ / mtha' gnyis la 'chol yang dag lam la sun 'byin pas/ / de dag tshig gis klu sgrub kyis bshad lam mi 'dor/ / don rnams rigs pa'i stobs kyis rnam 'gar gnas 'dod dang*/ / 'dus bya lam 'das de nyid tshad ma nges 'dzin pa/ / gnyis ka dngos 'dzin gdon chen mi zad khar song nas/ / lta ba'i mche ba rnon pos dam du zin pa yin/ / 'du byed tshogs 'di med ces yid la mi gnas par/ / snang don nyid dam de la yang dag 'gog smra ba yi/ / mi de gnyis kyang tshad ma'i lam las rnam nyams nas/ / log lta'i mya ngan rgya chen thang du nges par lhung*/ / sgyu ma gnyis med chos kun mi gnas dbu ma yi/ / lugs gnyis rnam 'byed de yang rmongs pa mtshar bskyed yin/ / dgag pa gtsor 'dzin rjes dpag shes la snang ba yi/ / dngos tshogs dge ba'i blo des sgrub dang dgag med par/ / tshad ma rnam gnas don gyi cha rnams spyod pa'i blos/ / don de bkag nas gzhan sgrub med ces nges par bzung*/ / rmi lam grong khyer zhig go zhes/ / 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gang yin des/ / btags don grong gi zhig pa nyid/ / grong nyid med na med pa ltar/ / yang dag nyid du dngos med ces/ / 'dzin pa'i blo yis btags pa'i don/ / yang dag bkag pa med nyid kyang*/ / yang dag dngos po med par min/ / 'di ltar yul med pa la ni/ / dgag pa 'jug pa srid ma yin/ / des na med ces nges bya ba/

/ dgag bya'i dngos po ma grub pa/ / de tshe dgag pa gtan bral na/ / blo yi mdun du gnas mi 'gyur/ / de ltar dngos po yod min la/ / de dgag pa yang ma grub na/ / de gnyis las 'das don 'ga' yang*/ / 'dzin pa'i yul du 'gro mi srid/ / des na shes bya'i mtshan ma las/ / blo yi g.yo ba rnam bzlog ste/ / spros tshogs nyer zhi bdag med pa'i/ / don la blo ni legs bzhag bya/ / de ltar stong nyid goms pa las/ / dngos 'dzin rab tu zhi ba dang/ / bdag med nyid kyang 'dzin med pa/ / de tshe yang dag mthong zhes bya/ / gang tshe lta ba'i dri ma kun/ / ye shes chu bos rnam sbyangs pas/ / de tshe shes dang shes bya dag / dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi/ / dper na chu la chu bzhag dang*/ / mar la mar ni rjes zhugs ltar/ / shes bya spros bral de nyid dang*/ / dbyer med ye shes rnam 'dres pa/ / de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / rang gzhan chos sku zhes byar brjod/ / de rjes shes bya'i rjes 'brangs can/ / rdzun snang 'jig rten ji srid pa/ / rig mdzad me long lta bu ni/ / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ / snga ma ji lta nyid mkhyen ni/ / 'khrul med mnyam bzhag blo 'jug med/ / phyi ma ji snyed mkhyen pa ni/ / 'khrul snang rjes thob blo 'jug can/ / sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku tshogs ni/ / gzhan gyi rnam rig snang ba ste/ / brgya byin gzugs brnyan la sogs dpe/ / mdo nas ji skad gsung de bzhin/ / de ltar theg chen bka' tshogs 'o ma'i mtsho bsrubs las/ / skyes pa'i bdud rtsi bla ma brgyud pa las rnyed 'di/ / gzhan phan nyid kyi phyogs su rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ / spring yig tshul du bgyis te khyed la gsol ba lags/ / dam pa khyed kyi chos spyod rab tu 'phel ba'i rgyu/ / sems bskyed cho ga yi dam spyod pa dang bcas 'di/ / legs par zhu/ dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis/ rga ston shes rab grags la sogs pa gtsong kha ru gsum gyi dge 'dun la springs pa'i yi ge bdud rtsi thig le zhes bya ba rdzogs so/
/ / / bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ rngog blo ldan shes rab kyi gsung chos skor/ rngog lo chen po blo ldan shes rab kyi spring yig bdud rtsi'i theg le bzhugs so// -PAGE 660--PAGE 661--PAGE 659-
